Celestron AstroMaster 70AZ

The classic sub-$200 first refractor.

around $110

A 70mm long-tube refractor on a simple alt-azimuth mount — the default answer to 'what's a good cheap first telescope?' for a decade. Won't rival an 8-inch Dob, but the Moon and planets look great and it's dead easy to use.

Why we like it

  • Very affordable entry point
  • Refractor — no collimation ever
  • Lightweight and portable

Keep in mind

  • 70mm limits deep-sky views
  • Basic mount is wobbly at high power
  • You'll outgrow it
